name: prefs-memory
description: Persistent, structured user preferences for every ZCode session. Prefs live in a 0600 JSON file (~/.zcode/prefs-memory.json) with id, text, scope (always/code/comms) and added date; a stdlib CLI covers set, get, list, remove, export. A SessionStart hook runs export at session start so the compact markdown pref block is injected automatically as additionalContext. Similar prefs dedupe on write; the store caps at 50 prefs.
